About

Design that starts with the business problem, not the blank canvas.

My work began with a simple fascination — how much a single visual can carry. Since then I've split my time between graphic design and interface design, which means I'm equally comfortable naming a brand, laying out a 40-page catalog, or wiring up a mobile app's onboarding flow.

At Deloitte Digital I design campaigns, presentations and brand systems for enterprise clients, and I've folded AI-assisted tools into that process — not to replace the thinking, but to get to the good ideas faster.
